    StartersVirginia ham biscuitsWarm buttermilk biscuits with Dijon butter and thin sliced hamHow to make it100g cold butter300g self-raising flour1 tsp salt200ml buttermilk40g butter, softened1 tbsp Dijon mustard200g thin-sliced leg hamHeat the oven to 220°C. Rub the cold butter into the flour and salt.Stir in the buttermilk and pat out the dough thick. Cut into rounds.Bake until risen and golden.Split warm, spread with butter mixed with Dijon and fill with ham.Snowbound loaded potato skinsCrisp potato skins with cheddar and bacon, sour cream and chivesHow to make it8 small potatoes40g butter, melted150g cheddar, grated150g bacon100g sour cream1 small bunch chivesBake the potatoes at 200°C until tender.Cook the bacon until crisp and crumble it.Halve the potatoes, scoop out most of the flesh and brush with butter.Crisp the skins at 220°C.Fill with cheddar and bacon and bake until melted.Top with sour cream and chives.Dulles departure lounge buffalo wingsStuck at the airport on Christmas EveHow to make itAs written, serves 4Wings dried and baked until crackling, tossed in hot sauce melted with butter, served with blue cheese dip and celery sticks.Pat 1.2kg chicken wings dry, toss with 2 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt and leave uncovered in the fridge for a few hours.Bake on a rack at 220°C for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp.Melt 60g butter with 120ml hot sauce and toss the wings through.Mix 100g crumbled blue cheese with 100g sour cream, 2 tbsp mayo and a squeeze of lemon.Serve with 4 celery sticks cut into batons.MainsGeneral Esperanza's snowbound chilliSlow braised beef chuck and mince with tomatoes and kidney beans, sour creamHow to make it600g diced beef chuck400g beef mince2 tbsp neutral oil1 onion2 tbsp chilli powder1 tsp ground cumin2 tins of chopped tomatoes (400g each)2 tins of kidney beans (400g each)120g sour cream100g cheddar, gratedBrown the chuck and mince in the neutral oil in batches.Add the chopped onion, chilli powder and cumin, then the tomatoes.Braise gently, covered.Add the drained kidney beans for the last stretch.Serve with sour cream and grated cheddar.Holly's in-flight chicken in white wineThe dinner service on Holly's flight, circling Dulles with the fuel running lowHow to make it8 chicken thigh fillets30g butter2 shallots250g button mushrooms150ml dry white wine250ml chicken stock150ml thickened cream1 tarragon300g long grain rice300g green beansSeason the chicken and brown in the butter. Lift out.Fry the sliced shallots and mushrooms for 5 minutes, then add the wine and bubble for 1 minute.Add the stock, put the chicken back and simmer for 20 minutes. Stir in the cream and chopped tarragon for the last 3 minutes.Simmer the rice with 600ml water, covered, for 12 minutes, then rest for 5.Boil the beans for 4 minutes and serve with the chicken and rice.SweetsChristmas cookiesGinger and cinnamon cookies made with brown sugar and golden syrupHow to make it125g butter100g brown sugar100g golden syrup300g plain flour2 tsp ground ginger1 tsp ground cinnamon1/2 tsp bicarbonate of soda200g icing sugarMelt the butter, sugar and golden syrup together. Stir in the flour, ground ginger, ground cinnamon and bicarbonate of soda to a dough.Chill the dough.Roll out and cut into planes and snowflakes.Bake at 180°C.Cool on a rack.Mix the icing sugar with a little water and ice the cookies.DrinksMcClane's bourbon eggnogEgg yolk, milk and cream eggnog with bourbon and nutmegHow to make it4 egg yolks80g caster sugar500ml milk250ml cream1 pinch nutmeg120ml bourbonfresh nutmeg, to tasteWhisk the yolks and sugar until pale.Warm the milk, cream and nutmeg until steaming, then slowly whisk into the yolks.Return to the pan and stir over low heat until it coats a spoon, without boiling.Cool, then stir in the bourbon.Chill.Pour into tumblers and grate fresh nutmeg on top.
